title.zh: 有限操作粒度的问答翻译与历史恢复
title.en: Question translation and history recovery across finite operation scales

statement.en: Every branching test of blocks, finite courses of one unfolding named as single steps, is a finer test holding at the same configurations; under excluded middle, where every block test agrees at two starts and the receiving side's moves have listed outcomes, every finite block history is matched.
statement.zh: 块是同一展开中被命名为一步的有限历程；块的每个分支检验都是在相同构型成立的较细检验；在排中律下，若每个块检验在两个起点一致且接收侧动作结果已列出，每段有限块历史都得到匹配。

laws.en: For any frame and any naming of blocks by finite words of moves, the frame of blocks has the same configurations and claims, a block going from s to t exactly where the course of its word does; a history of blocks goes from s to t exactly where the words written out do, through the same boundaries.
laws.zh: 对任一框架与以有限动作之词命名的块：块框架有相同的构型与断言，块从 s 到 t 恰当其词的历程如此；一段块历史从 s 到 t，恰当写出的诸词如此，经过相同的边界。

laws.en: For any frame and any naming of blocks by finite words, every branching test of blocks is a finer branching test, each block read as the course of its word, holding at the same configurations, with no premise: the frame of blocks translates into the finer frame.
laws.zh: 对任一框架与以有限词命名的块：块的每个分支检验都是一个较细的分支检验（每块读作其词的历程），在相同构型成立，无需前提：块框架可译入较细框架。

laws.en: For any two frames and any naming of blocks by finite words, configurations alike at the finer grain are alike in blocks, and configurations passing the same finer branching tests pass the same tests of blocks, with no premise.
laws.zh: 对任两个框架与以有限词命名的块：在较细粒度上相同的构型在块中也相同，通过相同较细分支检验的构型也通过相同的块检验，无需前提。

laws.en: Where every finer move is named by a block of that move alone, configurations pass the same tests of blocks exactly where they pass the same finer tests, and two descriptions whose kernels are passing the same finer tests and passing the same block tests identify the same configurations.
laws.zh: 每个较细动作都由只含该动作的块命名时，构型通过相同块检验恰当它们通过相同较细检验；核分别为“通过相同较细检验”与“通过相同块检验”的两个描述，认同相同的构型。

laws.en: For any process whose moves each have listed outcomes, the endpoints of each finite course from each configuration are listed, with no choice.
laws.zh: 对任一过程，若每个动作的结果都已列出，则从每个构型出发的每个有限历程的终点都已列出，无需选择。

laws.en: Under excluded middle, where the tests of G translate into F and those of G' into F', the translations agree at s and s', and each move of G' has listed outcomes, every history of G from s is matched by a history of G' from s' by the same moves, ending where the translations agree again.
laws.zh: 在排中律下：G 的检验译入 F、G' 的检验译入 F'，译文在 s 与 s' 处一致，且 G' 的每个动作结果已列出时，G 从 s 出发的每段历史都由 G' 从 s' 出发、同样动作的一段历史匹配，终点处译文再次一致。

laws.en: Under excluded middle, for two frames, each reading blocks named alike in its own words of different moves and lengths, where the readings of every block test agree at s and s' and the second frame's moves have listed outcomes, every course of blocks written out from s is matched by the same blocks written out from s', ending where the readings agree again.
laws.zh: 在排中律下，两个框架各以自己的、动作与长度不同的词读取同名的块：每个块检验的读法在 s 与 s' 处一致且第二框架的动作结果已列出时，从 s 写出的每个块历程都由从 s' 写出的同一串块匹配，终点处读法再次一致。

laws.en: For any joining read through retained references and any naming of blocks, a history of blocks extends the configuration it started from, by one fragment for each finer move written out, not for each block.
laws.zh: 对任一经保留引用读取的接合与任一块命名：一段块历史延伸其起始构型，每写出一个较细动作就加一个片段，而不是每块一个。

hypotheses.en: Supplied processes, finite expansion words and interpretation of common block/atomic questions; cross-articulation history recovery needs complete translated-answer agreement at the start, listed outcomes of the receiving side's moves and excluded middle.
hypotheses.zh: 给定过程、有限展开词、同一宏步骤及原子问题的解释；跨表述历史恢复需起点处完整翻译问答一致、接收侧动作结果已列出，以及排中律。

hypotheses.en: Reference preservation uses the joining's retained-reference frame, append-only; kernel equality additionally needs each finer move named by a block of itself and each description's kernel to be exactly its sameness of tests.
hypotheses.zh: 引用保持使用接合的保留引用框架（只追加）；核相等另需每个较细动作由只含它的块命名，且每份说明的核恰为其检验相同。

hypotheses.en: Excluded middle enters only as the named hypothesis of the matching laws; translation, sameness and listed endpoints use no premise.
hypotheses.zh: 排中律只作为匹配规律的明示前提出现；翻译、相同性与列出终点不用前提。

does_not_show.en: That two actual descriptions agree on every block test at the start, which matching takes, is not shown.
does_not_show.zh: 两份实际说明在起点处每个块检验上都一致（匹配所取的条件）未被表明。

does_not_show.en: Blocks are fixed finite words; variable or unbounded protocols, probabilities and guaranteed completion are outside these laws.
does_not_show.zh: 块是固定的有限词；可变或无界的协议、概率与完成保证不在这些规律之内。

does_not_show.en: Matching relates the boundaries of blocks; matching of positions inside blocks, and execution with physical resources, do not follow.
does_not_show.zh: 匹配关联的是块的边界；块内位置的匹配以及以物理资源执行，都不由此得出。

does_not_show.en: That every finer move is a block of its own is shown sufficient for the block tests to recover every finer test; that it is necessary is not shown.
does_not_show.zh: 每个较细动作自成一块，被证明足以使块检验恢复每个较细检验；其必要性未被表明。

detail.en: From one origin, two branches pass the same tests of completed blocks and of every nonempty prefix, while from one of them the continuation can be lost midway: no test of prefixes reads that loss.
detail.zh: 自同一起点的两个分支通过相同的完成块检验与每个非空前缀检验，而其中一支的接续可在中途失去：没有前缀检验能读出这一损失。

next_delta.en: Match positions inside blocks between two articulations with different internal syntax, and derive the starting agreement of block tests from how the two descriptions formed instead of supplying it.
next_delta.zh: 在内部语法不同的两种表述之间匹配块内的位置，并从两份说明如何形成推出起点处块检验的一致，而不是给定它。

correspondence.zh: 宏步骤由同一原过程的 Trace 构成，共享实际边界。跨过程问题的实际对应仍给定，不声称中间位置已经一一对应。
correspondence.en: Blocks are Trace paths of the same native process with actual shared boundaries. Actual cross-process question correspondence remains supplied; no bijection of internal positions is inferred.

detail.en: Reuse successor matching; one-way history lifting only needs receiving-side finiteness.

history.zh: 2026-10-15，整合 I3b（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述（新核心模块 Becoming.Granularity，新桥接 Becoming.GranularityBridge）。块是同一展开的有限路径（Frame.blocks），块的历史即写出的较细历史（Frame.blocks_trace_iff）；块的每个分支检验都是较细检验，在相同配置成立，不加前提（Frame.holds_blocks）。在较细粒度相同或同测的配置在块中亦然（Alike.blocks、SameBranchingTests.blocks）；每个较细动作自成一块时，块的检验恢复每个较细检验（Frame.blocks_sameBranchingTests_iff，充分非必要），两种描述的核相同（Frame.blocks_kernel_iff）。以另一粒度读同一展开的一般律：两框架的检验各自译入较细框架、译文在两配置处一致、接收侧每步结果列出时，前者的每段历史由后者以相同步匹配，终点译文仍一致（Translates.history_matches_of_em）；排中律为具名假设 em，外围的经典推理正在此处；列出的结果给出每段有限路径的终点，不用选择（outcomes_of_trace）。保留引用的块保持起点并计入其中每次形成（Joining.retained_blocks_extend，外围的登记模型编译后用 propext，故在核心的保留框架上重述）。桥接表明外围的块即核心的（blocks_ofModel，按定义），编译问题即较细检验（BranchingTest.toTest_finer）：compile_correct、blocks_trace_iff、singleton_coverage_recovers_questions、full_and_block_reduced_kernels 逐字成立，不加假设；finite_trace_endpoints 与 blocks_image_finite 外围以经典选择证明，核心不用选择；cross_granularity_history_matches 以 em 为假设。公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。外围证明及其回执保持原范围。
history.en: 15 October 2026, integration I3b (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine (new core module Becoming.Granularity, new bridge Becoming.GranularityBridge). A block is a finite course of the same unfolding (Frame.blocks), and a history of blocks is the finer history written out (Frame.blocks_trace_iff); every branching test of blocks is a finer test holding at the same configurations, with no premise (Frame.holds_blocks). Configurations alike, or passing the same tests, at the finer grain are so in blocks (Alike.blocks, SameBranchingTests.blocks); where every finer move is a block of its own, the tests of blocks recover every finer test (Frame.blocks_sameBranchingTests_iff, sufficient, not necessary) and two descriptions have one kernel (Frame.blocks_kernel_iff). The general law of reading one unfolding at another grain: where the tests of two frames translate into finer frames, the translations agree at two configurations and each move of the receiving side has listed outcomes, every history of the first is matched by one of the second by the same steps, ending where the translations agree again (Translates.history_matches_of_em); excluded middle is the named hypothesis em, which is where the periphery reasoned classically, and listed outcomes give the endpoints of every finite course with no choice (outcomes_of_trace). Blocks of retained references keep where the course started and count every formation within (Joining.retained_blocks_extend, restated on the core’s retained frame because the periphery’s register model compiles through propext). The bridge shows the periphery’s blocks are the core’s (blocks_ofModel, by definition) and its compiled questions the finer tests (BranchingTest.toTest_finer): compile_correct, blocks_trace_iff, singleton_coverage_recovers_questions and full_and_block_reduced_kernels hold as stated with no added hypothesis; finite_trace_endpoints and blocks_image_finite, chosen classically in the periphery, need no choice in the core; cross_granularity_history_matches holds with em. Empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). The periphery proofs and their receipts keep their scope.
